en: Sepia-toned street scene showing a busy urban square with many pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. In the background stands a grand neoclassical theater-like building with ornate façade and statuary on the roof. Other multi‑story buildings line the street, and a horse‑drawn carriage is visible on the right. At the top of the image the caption reads in Cyrillic and Latin characters.
